hints.title: Consecutive Ones Count
hints.text: A contiguous sequence of L consecutive ones contains exactly L * (L + 1) / 2 non-empty substrings of all ones.

hints.title: Single-Pass Run Tracking
hints.text: Scan the string while maintaining a running counter of consecutive 1 characters. Reset to 0 when 0 is encountered.

hints.title: Accumulate and Modulo
hints.text: At each 1 character, add the current consecutive count directly to the cumulative sum, taking modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all O(N^2) substrings is quadratic and causes time limit exceeded on N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan with running length accumulation uses O(1) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate recognizes that adding current streak length L at each step naturally sums to L*(L+1)/2.
